name: Piecewise Linear Volume Rendering (PL-NeRF)
definition: A volume rendering method that reformulates the sample-based rendering equation to correspond to the exact integral under the assumption of piecewise linear volume density (opacity) and piecewise constant color. It serves as a drop-in replacement for the classical rendering equation.
summary: Piecewise Linear Volume Rendering reformulates NeRFs using piecewise linear opacity to resolve quadrature instability and enable precise importance sampling via an invertible cumulative distribution function.
